project_name: Port of Fujairah Oil Industry Zone (FOIZ), 42M-Barrel Underground Cavern Storage & LNG Bunkering Hub
developer: ADNOC, Port of Fujairah & Fujairah Oil Industry Zone (FOIZ)
cat1_masterplan_and_site_layout: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Official engineering corridor/terminal layout published via https://fujairahport.ae/port-overview/infrastructure-overview/ and https://fujairahport.ae/contact-us/port-map/. Covers 4.50 km² (4.5M sq.m. industrial & marine zone) across Sakamkam / Qidfa Coastal Industrial Zone (World's largest underground crude oil rock cavern storage (42M bbl) + FOIZ terminal expansions + ADNOC/Port of Fujairah LNG bunkering & container quay deepening (-18m)).

cat3_tower_and_building_floor_plans: Not publicly available (Restricted Municipal/Consultant Portal) — Non-residential civil/industrial/utility complex (Civil / Industrial Infrastructure Complex (World's largest underground crude oil rock cavern storage (42M bbl) + FOIZ terminal expansions + ADNOC/Port of Fujairah LNG bunkering & container quay deepening (-18m))). Process building, terminal hall, and substation general arrangement (GA) drawings governed by authority tender packages (https://www.adportsgroup.com/en/clusters/ports).

cat7_landscape_and_infrastructure_plan: Available (Official Project Page / Brochure) — Primary civil, marine, rail, power, or water/wastewater utility tie-ins documented across https://fujairahport.ae/port-overview/infrastructure-overview/ and https://www.vtti.com/ (EPC Contractors: SK Ecoplant (South Korea), Six Construct (BESIX), NMDC, Technip Energies).
